en: Color image of a mid‑20th‑century city street with four‑ to five‑story apartment blocks featuring simple stucco facades and small balconies. A blue-and-white intercity or city bus is parked by the sidewalk; several pedestrians walk along the storefronts at ground level. Streetlights with curved arms and overhead trolley or tram wires run above the roadway. On the left, a tree‑lined park or boulevard with older cars is visible. The scene suggests an ordinary residential/commercial street in a European city during the socialist era.
